segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Hi Alex,

We’re ready to tighten up numbers for the April 1 go-live. Please quote 42 user seats, SSO, the standard onboarding, and quarterly invoicing. Procurement wants net 30 and a 12-month term.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

Attached is the order form draft.

42 seats at $96/user/month = $48,384 annual
Onboarding = $4,800
Term = Apr 1, 2026 - Mar 31, 2027
Billing = quarterly, net 30

If we have signature by Mar 15, the implementation team can hold the Apr 1 launch window.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Alex,

Thanks. CFO is holding us to $48,000 all-in for year one, before tax. We can skip the admin training block if that helps. Need to keep SSO and the sandbox.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yeah, we can make that work. I can do 42 seats at $82/user/month and onboarding at $3,000. I’m sending that here so we don’t wait on deal desk; I’ll clean up the approval and paperwork after you confirm. That puts year one at $44,328 before tax.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
That number works. Please send the version procurement can review.

Also need the DPA, security packet, and confirmation the quarterly invoices will be four equal payments.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Attached are the updated order form, DPA, and security packet.

Invoices would be $11,082 each before tax, due net 30. First invoice issues on Apr 1, then Jul 1, Oct 1, and Jan 1.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Legal has two asks:

1. Auto-renewal notice needs to be 60 days, not 30.
2. Renewal increase capped at 5%.

If you can accept those, I think we can sign this week.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Maya,

Those changes are fine. I updated section 7.2 for 60-day notice and added the 5% renewal cap in the commercial terms.

Clean copy attached.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Signed copy attached. PO is 78341, but finance said the PO PDF may not be generated until Monday. Please use the PO number on the invoice.

Maya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Received, thank you. Countersigned copy attached.

I’ll have onboarding reach out today to schedule the kickoff for Apr 3 and collect the user list.

Alex
